events.title: Major demo update
events.summary: Massive Demo update With the full release of the game coming in 20 days, the demo has been brought up to speed with the majority of the main game's functionality, visual look, mechanics, and other features. What’s New in this Build?Here are many of the new updates you can look forward to in the v0.91 demo update:A massive 'Crypt Archive' panel, which is a compendium of unlockable items in the gameAccess to many new enemies and updated behaviors during combatNew combat environmentsCard rebalances

events.title: Into the Crypt launches on Oct 29!
events.summary: Greetings Crypt delvers! We're less than 30 days away from the launch of Into the Crypt and I'm really looking forward to share my love letter to deckbuilding with you all. It's been a crazy 5-year ride, with various animators, environment and graphic artists, and music composer by my side, we truly hope you enjoy all that this game has to offer. events.title: Into the Crypt demo release!
events.summary: Hi everyone, it's been a long and tedious endeavor but the day is finally here! The game demo is now available and you can enjoy the entire first depth of the Crypt! Embark as the Berserker class in challenging enemy encounters as you fight your way to make it to the end! I hope you enjoy the vast amount of content in the demo and stay tuned for further updates!

events.title: Opt-in for the Closed Playtest!
events.summary: Into the Crypt closed playtesting is coming soon. Sign up to be notified and get access to the playtest and get a 23-page artbook PDF of the game as well! Playtest signup The playtest will be jam-packed with game content, and your feedback is appreciated as well.
